title: Schedule V tests.
bodyText: A substance shall be placed in schedule V if it has a degree of danger or probable danger less than the substances listed in schedule IV according to the determination made pursuant to section 329-11.
bodyHtml: [§329-21]  Schedule V tests.  A substance shall be placed in schedule V if it has a degree of danger or probable danger less than the substances listed in schedule IV according to the determination made pursuant to section 329-11. [L 1972, c 10, pt of §1]
